subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Gift of the gab
solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Talent for speaking**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Gift of the gab"** means having a talent for speaking, especially in a way that is persuasive or entertaining. (बातूनी होने की प्रतिभा)

 
 
• **Example:** He has the **gift of the gab**, which makes him an excellent salesperson.
 
 
 
• **"Talent for speaking"** refers to the natural ability to speak well and effectively, often in a way that persuades or entertains others. (बातूनी होने की प्रतिभा)

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Someone's precious gift** (किसी का कीमती उपहार): Something that is very valuable to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** The watch was **someone's precious gift** to him, and he cherished it deeply.
 
 
 
• **Very beautiful** (बहुत सुंदर): Extremely attractive or pleasing.
 
 
• **Example:** The sunset over the mountains was **very beautiful**.
 
 
 
• **Attached to God** (भगवान से जुड़ा हुआ): Having a strong connection with or devotion to God.
 
 
• **Example:** She is deeply **attached to God** and spends hours in prayer.
